none: PAS NLM-690243: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), an irregular copy of a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 10.6mm, Weight: 0.56gms, die axis: possibly 12
